note: Demo content for the home page showcase. Descriptions are adapted from the studio's own Facebook posts. Everything here is marked demo and removed with `pnpm demo:clear`. The hero video is one of her own reels (the alpona mug), muted, re-cut to 1280x720 with blurred edges, 12 s loop.

products.title: Alpona name mug
products.description: Your tea, your rules, your mug. A ceramic mug wrapped in a hand-drawn alpona pattern with your name or a short line in Bangla or English. Made to order in Melbourne and printed to last through the dishwasher.
products.alt: A blue and white alpona-patterned mug with Bangla lettering

products.title: Welcome sign (স্বাগতম)
products.description: A round hand-lettered welcome sign for a wedding, holud or housewarming, with স্বাগতম in bold Bangla lettering, painted flowers and a ribbon bow. Comes with a small easel so it stands at the door.
products.alt: A round welcome sign with স্বাগতম in red lettering and a ribbon bow

products.title: Leather earrings
products.description: Lightweight leather earrings cut in a leaf shape with a glitter edge and a patterned centre. Pick the colours to match an outfit, or send a photo of your saree and we match it for you.
products.alt: A pair of blue and gold leaf-shaped leather earrings on a card

products.title: Event poster
products.description: Bring poetry to your own space. A designed and printed poster for a cultural evening, community program or celebration, with Bangla typography and illustration drawn for the occasion. Supplied on board or canvas, with an easel if you need one.
products.alt: A Rabindra-Nazrul Jayanti poster standing on an easel

products.title: Personalised drink bottle
products.description: Not just a bottle, it is your identity. An insulated steel bottle printed with your name, a line that is yours and a little floral border. Want one with your name on it? Book a consultation and we will design it together.
products.alt: A white personalised drink bottle held up against a blue sky

products.title: Name and number keyring
products.description: Made with care, for those who care. A fabric keyring strap printed with a name and phone number, so keys, school bags and work lanyards always find their way home. Order one or a set for the whole team.
products.alt: Two printed keyring straps with a name and phone number

products.title: Best teacher ever mug
products.description: A token of gratitude for the one who inspires every day. A personalised teacher mug with their name and a cheerful design, made with love for end of year, Teachers' Day or a thank-you from the class.
products.alt: Four personalised Best Teacher Ever mugs

products.title: Coffee and tea kitchen sign
products.description: A framed kitchen sign with hand-lettered script, painted roses and a little coffee pot, for the corner where the kettle lives. Add a family name or a line of your own.
products.alt: A framed Coffee and Tea sign with painted roses

products.title: Boxed gift set
products.description: Why give something everyone can buy, when you can give something made only for your loved one? A kraft gift box packed with pieces chosen for one person: a mug, a small frame or candle, and a card with your words. Soft, personal and budget friendly.
products.alt: A kraft gift box with a mug and a candle, tied with twine, under fairy lights

products.title: Magic of Love couple mugs
products.description: Magic of Love: a pair of mugs with two little characters and a line for each of you. "A doctor saves love", "An engineer builds love", or whatever your story is. An anniversary gift that gets used every morning.
products.alt: Two couple mugs reading A doctor saves love and An engineer builds love

products.title: Saree-matching earrings
products.description: You pick the saree or dress, we create the matching earrings. Send a photo of your fabric and we design a pair in the same colours and pattern, so the whole look comes together for the wedding, holud or Eid.
products.alt: Orange patterned earrings on a card, laid on a red and gold saree

products.title: Eid Mubarak stickers
products.description: Round Eid Mubarak stickers in Bangla, in six colourways, for gift boxes, chocolate wrappers and envelopes. Add the family name or a short wish underneath. Sold in sheets.
products.alt: Six round Eid Mubarak stickers in different colours

products.title: Engraved door nameplate
products.description: Not the usual nameplate. A brushed metal door sign with engraved names and titles, made for a clinic, office or practice. Single names or a full list, in English or Bangla.
products.alt: A brushed metal door sign engraved with doctors' names

products.title: Calligraphy wall art
products.description: Islamic calligraphy painted in gold on a deep black canvas, ready to hang. A piece for a new home, a wedding gift or Eid, with the verse or phrase of your choice.
products.alt: Gold calligraphy on a black canvas being hung on a wall

products.title: Framed Eid art
products.description: A layered paper-cut Eid piece in a white frame: a crescent, a mosque silhouette and the family name, built up in coloured card. Made for the Eid table or the hallway wall.
products.alt: A woman holding a framed layered paper-cut Eid piece

products.title: Eid chocolate wrappers
products.description: Customised Eid chocolates for the team: sweet treats to say thanks and share the celebration. Each bar is wrapped in a printed sleeve with Eid Mubarak and a name, a perfect little gift for colleagues, neighbours and the kids' class. Price per bar.
products.alt: Hands holding a chocolate bar in a blue Eid Mubarak wrapper

products.title: Photo puzzle
products.description: Your photo, printed as a jigsaw puzzle. A gift that takes an evening to put together and then goes in a frame. Send the picture and we take care of the rest.
products.alt: Two photo jigsaw puzzles beside a bunch of roses

products.title: Personalised passport cover
products.description: A soft leather-look passport cover engraved with a name or initials. A small gift for someone flying home, a graduate, or a team heading to a conference.
products.alt: A pile of grey engraved passport covers

messages.text: Eid orders close two weeks before Eid.
Pickup in Melbourne or post across Australia.

testimonials.quote: [Sample quote] The nameplate arrived exactly as we imagined it, and the Bangla lettering was perfect. Our parents were thrilled.
[Sample quote] Shudha made fifty chocolate wrappers for our office Eid lunch in under a week. Everyone asked where they came from.
[Sample quote] I sent one photo of my saree and the earrings she made matched it exactly. Wore them to the wedding and got stopped all night.
